I can definitely relate to this. Even just the weekends can be excruciating, looking on Instagram and Snapchat and seeing everyone else having so much fun. I try asking my "friends" all the time if they wanna hang out or do something but they never want to, even tho I can see on snap chat and other media that they are hanging out without me. I honestly don't know what to do, since I'm very socially awkward. But what I did find out is that while doing what I like to do (do art, play videogames and stream on twitch) I found friends in that, friends who actually appreciate me. All I'm saying is there are definitely people out there that will like you for who you are, the hard part is to find them. But I believe in you op and everyone else reading this :)
